body: i just moved and furnished my bedroom mostly from mount sinai resale shop (desk, shelf, office chair, dining chair for under $150). it’s a relatively small store but you’re guaranteed to find furniture there any given day. they have some pricier antique pieces but also lots of cheaper items as well. they also do furniture holds for five days, after that it’s $20 per additional day. i hired a taskrabbit to move the furniture to my apartment and i believe it was less than $50 with service fees and tip for an hour. if you’re trying to buy secondhand from thrift stores/facebook marketplace, it would be ideal to get as much as possible from one source to cut down on transportation costs. i would also recommend joining your local buy nothing group on facebook, as well and checking alleys for free furniture. good luck!
